description: Fetches a public image and returns it resized, cropped or converted, as a base64 data URL with the output size. Fit modes scale-down, contain, cover, crop, pad. Max 4 MB output. 0.005 USDC per call via x402.

fit.description: scale-down, contain, cover, crop or pad

format.description: webp, avif, jpeg, png or auto

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

name: image_transform
